The decisive mistake was made by PublicationData_Expert at step 1. It did not look up how many articles Nature actually published in 2020. It adopted the manager's placeholder of 1000 articles and treated the significance threshold (α = 0.05) as the fraction of incorrect papers. That produced 50, which is wrong. The expected answer is 41, which depends on the real article count. Computer_terminal only executed the arithmetic, and VerificationExpert at step 3 checked the arithmetic but not the assumptions, so it confirmed the error rather than catching it.
